actions.title: Google/Apple configuration and product decision
actions.work: Preserve Google-login intent; choose supported web/PWA/native transport, exact environment clients/domains/scopes and qualifying iOS option. Verify provider readiness and required public policies.
actions.recheck: Verified configuration summaries, controlled provider sign-in/cancel/error and onboarding; IE01/IE04.

actions.title: Purpose-bound OAuth callback and session transfer
actions.work: Design a separate provider/linking transaction that binds intent, state/nonce/verifier, environment and initiating identity; preserve existing email-link isolation, account-switch guards and precise native origins.
actions.recheck: Real web/PWA/native lifecycle, tamper/replay/expiry/wrong-account and storage/handoff proof; IE01/IE03 with AU/NR dependencies.

actions.title: Linking and invitations preserve identity and access
actions.work: Validate actual automatic/manual linking and relay collisions; retain immutable Auth UUID ownership and server membership/seat/role/expiry rules. Include unfinished Admin invitations and social onboarding currencies; no client email-based account merge.
actions.recheck: Actual controlled identities, direct RPC acceptance/denial and existing finance/plan/selection preservation; IE02/IE04.

actions.title: Auth purpose templates and deployed route parity
actions.work: Repair tracked Business callback classification in the four subject/body templates; distinguish Admin setup from generic OTP and other Auth purposes. Keep escaped content and authentic link semantics; verify exact deployed templates/allowlist separately.
actions.recheck: Actual template rendering/negative-route local checks, reviewed deployed parity and controlled inbox confirmation/recovery/new/existing invitations; IE03/IE05.

actions.title: Bounded email architecture and delivery operations
actions.work: Keep working SMTP initially. Review a signed Auth Send Email Hook separately from a durable server-authorized application-email dispatcher/shared template layer. Define recipients/actions, dedup/retry/limits, privacy, monitoring and recovery before activation.
actions.recheck: Selected route approved/implemented, signature and token-mapping checks, durable queue/provider failure/recipient/revocation proof, rollback; IE05/IE06.

actions.title: Coordinated rollout and actual acceptance
actions.work: Bind exact source/settings/template/environment, provider credentials kept private, disposable recoverable accounts/inboxes and cleanup/rollback. Run the bounded 36-case matrix where ready; carry unavailable groups and dependencies to final remediation and full re-audit.
actions.recheck: Hosted/browser/device evidence with genuine Auth/provider identity/delivery, preservation and final declaration alignment; all IE groups and earlier AU/AM/NR actions.
